senses.gloss: f. (יָסַת, intensive of עָשָׂה; as to ע a. (ו) י, v. Nöld. Mand. Gr. p. 72) [habitual doing, condition,]

units: <cite ref="Sanhedrin 101a:1">Snh. 101ᵃ</cite>; <cite ref="Ketubot 110b:5">Keth. 110ᵇ</cite>, a. e. <he>שינוי ו׳ וכ׳</he> a change of diet is the beginning of bowel diseases.
<cite ref="Jerusalem Talmud Yoma 1:1:20">Y. Yoma I, 38ᶜ</cite> bot. <he>כל וו׳ טובה וכ׳</he> every kind of good manners was found among them.
<cite ref="Bereishit Rabbah 87">Gen. R. s. 87</cite> <he>כך הי׳ יֶסְתָּן שׁל וכ׳</he> this was the custom of the gentiles.
<cite ref="Mishnah Nedarim 9:9">Ned. IX, 9</cite> <he>כך היא וֶוסְתּוֹ של וכ׳</he> such is that man’s way of acting.

senses.gloss: regular date, or regular premonitory symptoms, of menstruation.
units: <cite ref="Mishnah Niddah 1:1">Nidd. I, 1</cite> <he>כל אשה שיש לה ו׳</he> every woman of regular days &c.
<cite ref="Niddah 4b:55">Ib. 4ᵇ</cite> <he>שלא בשעת וֶסְתָּהּ</he> out of her regular time.
<cite ref="Niddah 11b:45">Ib. 11ᵇ</cite> <he>אשה שאיו לה ו׳</he> a woman who has no regular time.

<cite ref="Mishnah Niddah 9:8">Ib. IX, 8</cite> (<cite ref="Niddah 63a:68">63ᵃ</cite>) <he>שיש לה ו׳</he> that has regular symptoms of approaching menstruation, v. infra. [Ib. 12ᵃ; 14ᵇ <he>שיעור ו׳</he>, v. <cite ref="A00593"><he>אֶוְותִּיאוֹס</he></cite>.] Tosef. ib. I, 11 <he>כיוונה שעת וסתה</he> she had her courses again (after an intermission) exactly at the usual date; Y. ib. I, 49ᶜ top <he>כיוונה מחמ׳ הווסת</he> (corr. acc.). Ib. <he>וו׳ ארוכה</he> a delayed menstruation (which may be expected any time), contrad. to <he>הפסק עונה</he> a skipping over of one course; a. fr.—Pl. <he>וֶסְתּוֹת</he>. Ib. IX, 8 <he>ואלו הן הו׳</he> and these are the symptoms of approaching &c. Ib. 63ᵃ <he>התם בו׳ דיומי</he> there (ib. I, 1) regularity of date is meant, <he>הכא בו׳ דגופא</he> here regularity of symptoms. Ib. 15ᵃ, a. e. <he>ו׳ דאורייתא</he> the rule requiring a woman to examine herself on the regular day is of biblical origin.

<cite ref="Yevamot 64b:22">Yeb. 64ᵇ</cite> bot. <he>ו׳ ושור וכ׳</he> the law concerning the mode of establishing a regularity of menstruation (<cite ref="Mishnah Niddah 9:10">Nidd. IX, 10</cite>) &c.—

<cite ref="Bereishit Rabbah 48:17">Gen. R. s. 48</cite> (expl. <cite ref="P00157"><he>עדנה</he></cite>, <cite ref="Genesis 18:12">Gen. XVIII, 12</cite>), v. <cite ref="F00069"><he>וֶוסְתָּנִית</he></cite>; a. fr.
